message.content:
Run /alert-report 24 inside this repository. The skill writes a new bilingual Markdown file to reports/YYYY-MM-DD-HHmm.md using Asia/Jerusalem local time (it auto-suffixes -2/-3 on filename collision — use whichever name was actually written).

After the file is written, persist it to the repository:
  1. git config user.email "routine-bot@noreply.claude.ai"
  2. git config user.name "pikud-hourly-digest"
  3. git add <the new file>
  4. git commit -m "chore(reports): hourly Pikud HaOref digest <YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm IDT>"
  5. git push origin HEAD

If the new file is byte-identical to the most recent existing report (no change in summary, no new history rows), skip the commit and push entirely — just report 'no change since last digest'. This keeps the commit log signal-rich.

Return three things and nothing else:
  - The absolute path of the file written.
  - The commit SHA (or 'no commit — content unchanged').
  - The remote URL of the pushed commit on GitHub (or 'not pushed').
